def factor_volume_impact_elasticity_long_smooth(df):
    """Estimate a smoother rolling price-response slope to changing participation."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change().replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    log_volume = np.log(df_copy["volume"].clip(lower=1.0))
    covariance = ret.rolling(60, min_periods=60).cov(log_volume)
    volume_variance = log_volume.rolling(60, min_periods=60).var(ddof=1)
    stable_variance = volume_variance.where(volume_variance > 1e-4)
    factor = covariance.div(stable_variance)
    factor = factor.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    df_copy["factor_volume_impact_elasticity_long_smooth"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_volume_impact_elasticity_long_smooth"]
formula: Cov_60(return, log(volume)) / Var_60(log(volume)) when Var_60(log(volume)) > 1e-4, otherwise NaN
rationale: Measures the rolling price-response elasticity of participation: the 60-session covariance between close-to-close returns and log volume divided by the rolling variance of log volume. The longer window smooths transient covariance estimates, while the variance floor avoids unstable ratios during near-constant-volume periods.
